scope: Canonical PR-based CI/security verification, focused local policy, same-release controller reuse proof and denial-only pre-refresh authorization/budget admission.
riskAnalysis: Retain one exact-head full hosted STRICT plus Redis/CodeQL/Browser/review; PR must remain open. No security scan is replaced by a skipped result. New configuration preflight only adds early denials inside existing CAS and cannot grant or expand execution authority. New-source environment pins remain mandatory.

threatModel.assets: Exact source qualification, task/release authority, financial exposure and immutable records.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Canonical PR-head CI is authoritative for full Linux regression; local focused and Windows-specific evidence remain distinct. Existing authenticated owner/controller and server-pinned review are unchanged.
threatModel.abuseCases: No-PR qualification, fork-name skip, stale CI reuse, source/workspace substitution, exhausted authority, insufficient or malformed financial accounting.
threatModel.mitigations: All-PR-to-main coverage without branch/actor/draft bypass, exact head checkout, main and scheduled security retained, separate Browser qualification, fresh one-time approvals and CAS-bound complete accounting/sequence checks.

rollback: Revert reviewed efficiency source on the feature branch, retaining every original approval, attempt, reservation and failed/cancelled qualification. Never reactivate consumed authority or remove historical records.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Focused and existing security cases cover malformed-response with unchanged source/authority/spending boundaries; failures and cleanup remain preserved and no automatic provider retry is introduced.

defects.rootCause: Feature pushes and their PR synchronizations launch duplicate exact-head CI and CodeQL runs. Operators repeated a full local suite before the same full hosted suite and had not verified existing same-release configuration reuse. Configuration admission did not reject known exhausted consent or funding before expensive provider refresh.
defects.detectionGap: Prior policy kept event-specific duplicate routes and described environment checks without a complete early financial/sequence preflight.
defects.regression: Workflow contract mutation tests, native-controller two-fresh-approval reuse without fetch, and actual CAS preflight denials preserving history; existing strict qualification remains authoritative.
defects.historicalPrevention: Use canonical PR checks once, focus local checks, batch publication, check preparation eligibility before provider mutations and reuse only exact verified configuration with fresh attempt identities.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing workflows, controller, sequence helpers, CAS and budget only; no new orchestration, service or credential.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No dependency installation or infrastructure change; existing build smoke/docs-ignore remain.
proactiveReview.threats: Skipped source coverage, unauthenticated review claims, stale authority and financial reset.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Closed PR means no qualification; absent/expired/exhausted consent or invalid accounting denies configuration without writes. Cleanup/reset remains available.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Missing PR/security trigger, duplicate push trigger, forged draft/path bypass, prior approval replay, source/workspace substitutions, expired/stopped/exhausted cohorts and full-state root reservations.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: QA independently reviewed Auditor preflight; Auditor independently reviewed QA workflow changes and root documentation/reuse fixture. Neither self-approves its own implementation.
proactiveReview.recovery: Preserve cancelled intermediate Browser run and original count-only failed attempt. No blind provider retries; no paid request until canonical checks and exact source/configuration gates pass.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused215passed; one canonical full hosted STRICT/Redis/CodeQL/Jekyll and automatic actual Browser artifact qualification remain required. No new full local run merely to duplicate the same hosted suite.
